title: crepinia × dumetorum
intro: Crepinia × dumetorum, commonly known as the Bicolored Spider Orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to the tropical forests of West Africa. The plant is known for its unique, almost exclusively white and yellow flowers, which are highly prized by orchid enthusiasts. Crepinia × dumetorum is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, and is traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
